title: Ribbon graphs and meromorphic functions
summary: Let Y be a compact Riemann surface, phi:Y -> CP^1 a meromorphic function, and Gamma in Y a ribbon graph avoiding the critical points of phi. Then phi(Gamma) is an immersed graph in CP^1. Conversely, given an immersion im:Theta to bCP^1 of an abstract multigraph Theta without vertices of valence 1 or 2, we describe a construction of a compact Riemann surface Y and a meromorphic function phi_{im}:Y in CP^1 such that phi_{im}(Gamma)=im(Theta).
